symptom: describe → exec of a page turns a caption stored as en_US '' + nl_NL 'Knop' into en_US 'Knop' (the Dutch is lost, the English invented); a textarea's placeholder disappears with all nine of its translations. mx check: 0 errors
cause: Two describe-side gaps. selectTranslationText/pickTextTranslation fell back to another language when the preferred one was present but EMPTY, and exec writes whatever describe prints into the preferred language. The TextArea case of parseRawWidget/outputWidgetMDLV3/buildTextAreaV3 never read, printed or built a Placeholder (only TextBox did)
insight: A readability fallback in DESCRIBE is a WRITE on the round trip: the fallback value lands in the language the statement authors. Present-but-empty is a stored value, not a gap — fall back only when the language has no entry. And the audit's '113 → 102 translations' was mostly one textarea placeholder, not empty-English texts: count losses per owning widget (name + path) before diagnosing, because a multiset count hides which property went
